_comment: v3.1.x WS3 fresh-18-dim v2 reranker + hybrid. The old v2 checkpoints are 9-dim-query and unusable; train.py reads dataset.query_dim dynamically so a fresh 18-dim v2 needs ZERO code change. General-first (one v2 over ALL tasks, --include-tasks default = all; v2's internal BCE/MSE routes per task). Grid over small {hidden_dim,num_layers} (tiny-by-design 44k-200k params), single grid seed; the winner is refined over refine_seeds. Per task the existing v2_reranker.py reports v3.1-alone / v3.1+v2 / oracle ndcg@10 over the v3.1 baseline's top-C. Gate: a task whose general-v2 closes < gap_close_threshold of the v3.1->oracle ndcg@10 gap is flagged; with auto_pertask a per-task v2 (--include-tasks that task) is then trained for the winner config and re-measured (the locked gated decision).
